subject: POC evaluation checkpoint — Milestones, owners, and outstanding blockers
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@catalytichealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC evaluation checkpoint — Milestones, owners, and outstanding blockers

Hi Olivia (and team),

Following up from last week's demo — attaching the baseline MAP and evaluation template so we have one source of truth for milestones and owners. This week's objective is to confirm the remaining gating items that could affect the proposed go/no-go on 2026-08-05. Quick summary below: 

- Integration: data ingestion pipeline and sample dataset validated by Catalytic.
- Latency: must hit 300ms p95 for 2k-token inference in the dedicated environment.
- Quality: acceptance checklist includes top-10 precision on labeled validation set and no regression on hallucination checks.

Can you confirm the items Catalytic will own this week versus items Redwood will own? If helpful, I'm proposing a 30-min sync on Friday to lock owners and any compensating controls for the latency gap.

Attachments: redwood-eval-template.xlsx (MAP + acceptance criteria), network-diagram.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Olivia Park <olivia@catalytichealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Leah Summers <leah.s@catalytichealth.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC evaluation checkpoint — Milestones, owners, and outstanding blockers

Marissa — thanks for the doc. Quick update from our side: 

- Integration: ETL team finished the initial ingestion connector yesterday; we pushed 10k rows to the staging S3 bucket. Logs attached (integration-logs.zip).
- Dataset: validation set is ready but we still need Redwood's script to run the hallucination checks (file in the eval template). Can you confirm a runtime window for the script?
- Latency: current numbers in our dev env are ~480ms p95 for 2k tokens; we have a perf lead working with your team to tune batching.

Owner split proposal: 
- Catalytic: dataset labeling, edge-case coverage, security sign-off (Leah).
- Redwood: inference tuning, KV cache config, and acceptance script delivery (Marissa/Connor).

Blockers we have:
1) We need the acceptance script and the exact hardware profile (GPU/instance) you'll run the POC on.
2) SOC/attestation checklist — Leah will need the logging/audit sample for compliance.

We can do a 30-min sync Friday at 10am ET. Does that work?

—Olivia
Head of Data Products
Catalytic Health
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@catalytichealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC evaluation checkpoint — Milestones, owners, and outstanding blockers

On Thu, Jul 16, 2026 at 09:05 AM Olivia Park <olivia@catalytichealth.com> wrote:
> Marissa — thanks for the doc. Quick update from our side: ...

Thanks, Olivia — good progress. Folowing up from our internal run yesterday: 

Meeting notes (quick):
- Redwood ran a dry-run of the acceptance checks on a 1k-token subset. Script and result summary uploaded to the shared Drive link.
- Latency: we reproduced ~440ms p95 on a T4-profiled staging node; moving to A10G drops to ~315ms with batching and quantization flags.
- Security: putting together a one-page log sample for Leah (audit_traces.txt) and a minimal SOC evidence bundle.

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Redwood: finalize and share acceptance script (Connor) — ETA Tue 2026-07-20 EOD.
- Catalytic: finalize labeled validation set and send final CSV (Olivia/Leah) — ETA Wed 2026-07-21.
- Redwood infra: provision a dedicated A10G node for the POC week and share instance details (Rishi) — ETA Wed 2026-07-21.
- Joint: Friday 07/23 — dry-run full evaluation (both teams present).

Acceptance criteria (draft):
1) Functional: model responds to evaluation prompts with no more than 5% critical hallucinations on labeled set.
2) Perf: p95 latency <= 350ms for 2k-token sequences on the dedicated A10G node.
3) Stability: no crashes or OOMs during a 24-hour continuous load replay at expected throughput.

Major open blockers: lack of final labeled set and missing acceptance script. Both are on the critical path for the 08/05 go/no-go.

—Connor
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@catalytichealth.com>, Leah Summers <leah.s@catalytichealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: MAP checkpoint — Updated owners, timeline, and ask before 08/05 decision

Hi Olivia & Leah — quick roll-up before Friday's dry-run. Appreciate the team's responsiveness so far. Below is the updated single-line MAP and asks we want closed by EOD Wed 07/28 to keep the 08/05 acceptance target intact.

Current MAP (single-line owners):
- Data & labels: Catalytic (Olivia, Leah) — deliver final CSV and labeling notes by 07/21 (Catalytic missed the 07/21 ETA; new ETA requested).
- Acceptance script: Redwood (Connor) — committed 07/20; one minor fix deployed 07/21.
- Infra provisioning: Redwood infra (Rishi) — A10G instance provisioned; instance id: a10g-rc-042 (details in Drive).
- Security artifacts: Redwood (Rishi) + Catalytic (Leah) — audit sample ready; full SOC checklist targeted 07/28.

Asks to Catalytic (this week):
1) Final labeled validation CSV and labeling guidance (new requested ETA: 07/28).
2) Confirm acceptance of the A10G instance profile for POC testing.
3) Share any legal/contract redlines that would prevent a production pilot — we need these flagged to Finance before 07/30.

If those three asks are OK, we proceed with the dry-run on 07/23 and a final acceptance evaluation window 07/29–08/02. Otherwise, we will need to push the go/no-go to 08/19 (risk window).

Attachments: redwood-eval-template.xlsx (updated v1.2)

Please reply with a short confirmation or the items you cannot commit to this week so we can triage.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
